{
  "milestones": [
    {
      "id": "m1",
      "title": "add cache option to remap",
      "requests": [
        "R4"
      ],
      "requirement": "I want iterutils.remap to accept a cache option so that already-visited objects can be reused, preventing infinite recursion on circular structures and mapping repeated references only once.",
      "observable": "A unit test builds a self-referential list `a = [1]; a.append(a)` and calls `remap(a, cache=True)`, expecting a list result whose recursive element is the result itself and no RecursionError. The same call with `cache=False` is expected to raise RecursionError. A duplicate-reference test such as `inner = {'x': 1}; out = remap([inner, inner], cache=True)` expects `out[0] is out[1]`.",
      "public_names": [
        "remap",
        "cache"
      ],
      "requires": [],
      "why_requires": ""
    },
    {
      "id": "m2",
      "title": "forward cache option through research",
      "requests": [
        "R4"
      ],
      "requirement": "I want iterutils.research to accept the same cache option as remap and pass it through when it uses remap to traverse a structure.",
      "observable": "A unit test calls `research(a, query=lambda path, key, value: False, cache=True)` on a cyclic list `a` and expects an empty list without RecursionError; calling `research(a, query=lambda path, key, value: False, cache=False)` is expected to raise RecursionError.",
      "public_names": [
        "research",
        "cache"
      ],
      "requires": [
        "m1"
      ],
      "why_requires": "research calls remap; m1 adds the public `cache` parameter to `remap`, which research must forward."
    },
    {
      "id": "m3",
      "title": "fix split maxsplit zero",
      "requests": [
        "R5"
      ],
      "requirement": "I want iterutils.split with maxsplit=0 to return the source's values rather than wrapping the original source object.",
      "observable": "A unit test calls `split(iter([1, 2, 3]), sep=2, maxsplit=0)` and expects `[[1, 2, 3]]`, not a wrapped iterator object; it also calls `split([1, 2, 3], sep=2, maxsplit=0)` and expects `[[1, 2, 3]]`, while existing nonzero maxsplit behavior remains unchanged.",
      "public_names": [
        "split",
        "maxsplit"
      ],
      "requires": [],
      "why_requires": ""
    }
  ],
  "expected_causes": [
    "The meaning of `cache` could be misunderstood as only a user-supplied mapping instead of an enabled/disabled traversal cache.",
    "`research` may accept `cache` but fail to forward it to `remap`, or may change its return shape while trying to cache matches.",
    "The `split` fix may special-case only list sources and still wrap generators/ranges, or may alter `maxsplit=1` and other maxsplit values.",
    "RecursionError expectations may be environment-sensitive if the implementation uses a different cycle-detection error."
  ],
  "verifier_plan": "Hidden tests will exercise the public API only. For m1, tests call `remap` directly with cyclic and duplicate structures, asserting `cache=True` returns cached/self-referential results and `cache=False` raises RecursionError. For m2, tests call `research` with the same structures and query, asserting the `cache` keyword is accepted and propagated through remap. For m3, tests call `split` with `maxsplit=0` on iterators/ranges/lists and assert the returned first chunk contains the source values, plus regression checks for ordinary splitting."
}
